issues.description: Stock.add(String) return type mismatch: the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares Stock.add(String) as returning void (+add(String): void), while both the template and the reference solution implement Stock.add(String) with signature 'public int add(String ingredient)'. This inconsistency leaves students unsure whether to implement/expect an int result (current code/tests) or void (UML/spec).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and code consistent. Preferred: update the UML/spec in problem_statement.md to declare '+add(String): int' to match the template and solution. Alternatively, if the intended behaviour is void, change the template and solution implementations to return void and update any call sites/tests accordingly.

issues.description: SealSaloon.stock declaration is ambiguously specified: earlier in the text the saloon is described as needing a 'final Stock stock' (an instance-level final field), but later the problem statement explicitly lists the 'stock' attribute as one of the elements that 'must be static'. The reference solution declares 'private static final Stock stock = new Stock();'. This contradictory wording can confuse students whether to declare an instance final field or a static final field.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify the problem statement and UML to unambiguously require either an instance-level 'final Stock stock' or a shared 'static final Stock stock'. Prefer aligning the instructions and UML with the reference solution by explicitly stating: 'declare stock as private static final Stock stock' (shared across all SealSaloon instances). If the pedagogical intent was instance-level, remove the requirement that 'stock' be static and update the solution/tests accordingly.
